steps.en: Letter reminders are produced and sent to the printer
steps.id: Surat reminder dibuat dan dikirim ke percetakan
steps.why_en: The daily run is switched off in the program and upload to the printer is turned off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Jalur harian dimatikan di program dan pengiriman ke percetakan dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: Officer turns letter reminders on or off from the portal
steps.id: Officer menyalakan atau mematikan surat reminder dari portal
steps.why_en: Only a deployment setting exists; the portal has run-now buttons but no on/off switch.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pengaturan deployment; portal punya tombol jalankan sekarang tapi tidak ada saklar on/off.

steps.en: Letter reminders can be set per notice type
steps.id: Surat reminder bisa diatur per jenis notice
steps.why_en: The letter run covers every stage for every notice type with no per-type setting.
steps.why_id: Proses surat mencakup semua stage untuk semua jenis notice tanpa pengaturan per jenis.

steps.en: SMS and email reminders are sent for the reminder stages
steps.id: Reminder SMS dan email dikirim untuk stage reminder
steps.why_en: Sending is switched off in production settings, and email is skipped for driver notices.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, dan email dilewati untuk notice pengemudi.

steps.en: Officer excludes chosen people from SMS and email reminders
steps.id: Officer mengecualikan orang tertentu dari reminder SMS dan email
steps.why_en: The list works per person only, not per notice type, and everyone is sent to if it fails to load.
steps.why_id: Daftar hanya per orang, bukan per jenis notice, dan semua orang dikirimi kalau daftar gagal dimuat.

steps.en: Electronic reminders can be turned on or off per notice type
steps.id: Reminder elektronik bisa dinyalakan atau dimatikan per jenis notice
steps.why_en: Only one global switch exists in the settings files; there is no per-type switch.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada satu saklar global di file pengaturan; tidak ada saklar per jenis.
